scope: Core recompilation diagnostic candidate; no title execution
trace_control: Compile-time opt-in only. The diagnostic executable always includes a one-shot trace; there is no runtime environment switch.
checks: Independent review reran 128 synthetic dispatch fixtures, both failing negative controls, and compared 242 disabled-arm instructions with the original.
limitations: No runtime invocation or causality proof. Synchronous first-call logging can perturb execution; a filtered or unavailable logger can consume the one-shot without retaining a line. Copied matching DLLs prepare a pair but do not qualify its runtime.
next: After the user-owned manual session ends, retain a separately admitted probe with exact loaded pair hashes, actual callback line, process exit and exception evidence. Full offline/Rust/SBS/browser gates remain open.
